## Readiness checklist

- [ ] The diff is limited to the linked issue and, when applicable, the accepted PEP and plan.
- [ ] Current behavior, accepted intent, and explanatory documentation do not conflict.
- [ ] Acceptance evidence maps to the relevant requirement IDs or direct-issue criteria.
- [ ] Privacy-sensitive or local research data is absent from the diff and test evidence.
- [ ] Compatibility, migration, rollout, and rollback are addressed or explicitly not applicable.
- [ ] `verify-change` was run with fresh evidence.
- [ ] `review-change` was run against the three-dot branch diff.
- [ ] Any live smoke check was explicitly authorized by the user.
